title: Organic Fertilizers
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Organic Fertilizers - New Advances and Applications delves into the most recent research and development in organic fertilizers, covering their application, production, and crop productivity benefits. Experts in agricultural science explore the effects of various organic fertilizers, such as compost, animal dung, and biofertilizers, on plant growth, nutrient uptake, and soil health. The book also discusses current breakthroughs in organic fertilizer manufacturing, such as microbial inoculants and practical case studies in using organic fertilizers. It is a useful resource for agricultural scientists, researchers, farmers, and policymakers.
